models.name: Qwen3.8-27B (TensorFold M3 Ultra)
models.full_name: Qwen3.8-27B 4-bit on TensorFold + DFlash2 vs stock MLX on an M3 Ultra
models.why: Yves LaRose's benchmark shows TensorFold finished 256-token replies only 3.8-5.3 percent sooner than stock MLX at 8K-32K on an M3 Ultra - and the real gap was context reuse, where a 64GiB cache cut a repeated 64K-context request from 632s to 16s.

engines.hardware: M3 Ultra, 512GiB unified memory, TensorFold + DFlash2
